source.notes: ICSE Class IX school second semester examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'II SEMESTER EXAMINATION, FEB. - 2025', 'Class - IX', 'Time: 2 hrs.', 'Sub: Chemistry', 'M.M.: 80'; examYear 2025 as printed. Footer prints '[ Internal Assessment - 20 Marks ]'. Section A (40 Marks) as printed starts at Q2 (no Question 1 appears in the file) and its printed marks add up to 25 only, so part of Section A may be missing from the scan. Section B (40 Marks, attempt any four) reuses the numbers: only 'Q2' (first question) and '7' (last question) are printed; the four questions in between carry no number on the scan and are numbered 3-6 from the sequence. To keep (number, part) unique, Section B questions are stored with a 'B' prefix (B2-B7). Several Section B parts have no printed marks (recorded as 0, LOW). Group totals printed for 'Name the Following', 'Fill in the blanks' and 'Match the columns' are kept as single entries. Handwritten ticks, question marks and strike-throughs on the scan were ignored. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text:
Name the Following:
Name the method by which Alkali metals can be extracted.

Name the Following:
Name the central part of an atom where protons and neutrons are held together.

Name the Following:
Name the metal which can displays hydrogen from Alkalis.

Name the Following:
Name two gases which can be collected by downward displacement of water.

Name the Following:
Name the gas which turns lead acetate paper black.
Draw orbital structure of Calcium oxide.
A sample of Nitrogen having volume 400 ml at a pressure of 4 atm is compressed to a volume of 200 ml. What amount of pressure will be required for this, if the temperature is kept constant.

Fill in the blanks:
Ozone layer exists in _______ region of atmosphere.

Fill in the blanks:
Nitrogen dioxide gas turns _______ litmus to _______.

Fill in the blanks:
The force exerted on a unit area of the wall of a container by a gas molecule enclosed in it, is equal to the _______ of the gas.

Fill in the blanks:
Group 17 elements are known as _______.

Fill in the blanks:
In the formation of a oxygen molecule _______ electrons are shared by each atom of oxygen.
Give Reasons: 1. Why elements in the same group have similar chemical properties? 2. Why is hydrogen placed in group 1 and group 17 of the periodic table.
